verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents built-in AI features that work from the user's own requests: they suggest request names, generate structured payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases. That counts as in-product AI suggestions, but it is generative assistance rather than analytical insights drawn from the user's data. Missing for 10: AI insights or analysis of API response data or usage, in-depth docs on how suggestions are derived, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI-powered features in Hoppscotch to rename requests, generate payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically.
These include renaming of API requests, generation of structured request payloads, and scripting capabilities for pre-request logic and test cases.
